added.prompt: Create a luxury minimalist birthday milestone poster featuring a giant 3D number “[AGE]” carved into a premium ivory-white wall. A stylish person is naturally sitting, leaning, or hanging from the number, posing confidently. Elegant floral arrangements with white roses, baby's breath, hydrangeas, and pastel blue balloons frame the composition. Soft natural sunlight, premium editorial photography, modern celebration aesthetic, clean luxury design, subtle shadows, sophisticated typography. At the top, display the name “[NAME]” in elegant serif font, followed by “CHAPTER [AGE]” and the quote “365 More Days of Miracles.” Neutral beige and white color palette, high-end event styling, dreamy atmosphere, photorealistic, magazine-quality portrait, ultra-detailed textures, luxury birthday photoshoot, Instagram-worthy, shallow depth of field, soft lighting, 8K masterpiece, professional fashion photography.

added.description: 把巨型生日年龄作为人物座位的两张成人里程碑海报。姓名与年龄是需填写的模板变量，画面数字和姓名仅为原作示例，不确认真人身份或生日；原帖未提供身份参考输入，不保证只填名字即可保留本人长相。8K为提示词要求非实测。
